_comment: GOLD, STAGE TWO (#120). The dominant commercial route is pyrometallurgical: the concentrate
goes to a copper smelter, gold rides the copper phase through converting, and drops out as
anode slime at electrorefining. The Cupola Furnace is already a RecipeType.BLASTING machine and
already the iron gate, so it is this mod's smelter and nothing new is needed.
A NUGGET, not an ingot. You are recovering trace amounts from rubbish; a whole ingot per batch
Blasting rather than smelting, which is also the gate: a vanilla furnace cannot run a blasting
recipe at all, and a vanilla blast furnace costs five iron ingots, so it is unreachable before

iron. Gold cannot be short-circuited with a furnace made of stone. A vanilla blast furnace CAN run it, which is fine: that costs five iron ingots, so it sits behind the same iron gate the Cupola does.
